name: narration-utils

metadata.description: Unused files, exports and dependencies across the workspaces (knip.jsonc). Gated at zero: fix the finding, or add an ignore with a reason.

$comment: The workspace root and the nx release project. `nx release version` counts a commit toward the version when it affects a release project or a project one depends on, so this list keeps every commit that counted before the per-project split counting (the UI and desktop projects were already separate and stay out). scripts/ci/projects.test.mjs keeps the list complete. Per-project targets live in each project.json.
